answer: The lagoon register is checked at draw time, relic lists the eligible set, and prism seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 52 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an farming party pays for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 52 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. Each impostor pays 19 dollars up front. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
